metric.description: Precision/recall F1 over the set of resistance determinants. Names are normalised for formatting only - case, whitespace and the parentheses in forms like tet(B) - so that tetB and tet(B) are one determinant. Allele numbers are preserved, so blaCTX-M-15 and blaCTX-M-65 remain distinct determinants, because they are different enzymes with different substrate profiles rather than two spellings of one thing.
